name: @flowforge/cordis-client-runner
description: FlowForge dynamic-package browser runner (A10, D50): injectable-seam port of the dsh `@deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-client-runner` client half. Turns a model-authored browser-half source into a live, guard-facade-wrapped plugin on the page — per-package load/unload queueing, converged load-by-run-id, ownership index for render-crash attribution, a whitelisting context facade over package-local injected ports, the Cordis run orchestrator (approve / decline / start / reconcile), the inspect registry, and the client timer Service. Zero `@deepseek-ai/*` / `@cat-cafe/*` / `@clowder-ai/*` references and no direct cordis Service/Context feathers: every originally-cordis or dsh dependency is expressed as a package-local injected port with a real in-memory implementation.
